stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

on the last line of your reply:

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

===== global_task_0d369ea4_solve_code_and_test_prediction
task-0d369ea4: exact verified solve(g) source (match all 7 demos). Reuse for similar 'extension/cascade' tasks.

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    painted_a=set()
    def fg(rr,cc): return out[rr][cc]==g[rr][cc] and g[rr][cc]!=bg
    for r in range(H):
        row=g[r]
        if all(v!=bg for v in row): continue  # full row exempt
        runs=[]; c=0
        while c<W:
            if row[c]!=bg:
                s=c
                while c<W and row[c]!=bg: c+=1
                runs.append((s,c-1))
            else: c+=1
        rightmost=max(c for c in range(W) if row[c]!=bg)
        blocked=False
        if rightmost>=0:
            iso=(rightmost==0 or row[rightmost-1]==bg)
            if iso and rightmost<W-1: blocked=True
        apaint=[]
        if [x for x in runs if x[1]-x[0]+1>=2] and not blocked:
            end=max(x[1] for x in runs if x[1]-x[0]+1>=2)
            if end<W-1:
                for c in range(end+1,W):
                    out[r][c]=1; apaint.append((r,c)); painted_a.add((r,c))
        for (rr,cc) in apaint:
            if rr+1<H and g[rr+1][cc]!=bg and (rr+1,cc) not in painted_a and out[rr+1][cc]==g[rr+1][cc]:
                out[rr+1][cc]=1
        if any(v!=bg for v in row):
            for c in range(W):
                if g[r][c]!=bg and out[r][c]==g[r][c]:
                    if 0<r<H-1 and fg(r-1,c) and fg(r+1,c): out[r][c]=1
    return out

def stray_analysis(gi, go, bg):
    H2,W2 = len(gi), len(gi[0])
    blocks=set()
    for r in range(H2):
        for c in range(W2):
            v=gi[r][c]

    A=np.array(gi)

    strays=[(r,c) for r in range(H2) for c in range(W2) if gi[r][c]!=bg and go[r][c]==bg]
    repairs=[(r,c) for r in range(H2) for c in range(W2) if go[r][c]!=bg and gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    rows=Counter(r for r,c in strays); cols=Counter(c for r,c in strays)
